Package neqsim.process.safety.release

Class TwoPhaseDriftFluxClosure

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.release.TwoPhaseDriftFluxClosure
final class TwoPhaseDriftFluxClosure extends Object
Shared bounded Zuber-Findlay/Harmathy closure for one gas and one liquid phase.

    • solve

      static TwoPhaseDriftFluxClosure.Result solve(ReleaseState reference, double surfaceTensionNm)
      Solves phase-area, kinetic-energy and drift-flux closure.
      Parameters:
      reference - thermodynamic state with exactly one gas and one liquid phase
      surfaceTensionNm - caller-declared interfacial tension in N/m
      Returns:
      immutable closure result

    • residual

      private static double residual(ReleaseState reference, TwoPhaseDriftFluxClosure.PhaseBasis basis, double slipRatio, double driftVelocity)
      Evaluates the drift-flux residual at one slip ratio.
      Parameters:
      reference - thermodynamic state
      basis - validated two-phase basis
      slipRatio - gas velocity divided by liquid velocity
      driftVelocity - Harmathy drift velocity in m/s
      Returns:
      drift-flux residual in m/s

    • closure

      private static TwoPhaseDriftFluxClosure.Result closure(ReleaseState reference, TwoPhaseDriftFluxClosure.PhaseBasis basis, double slipRatio, double surfaceTensionNm, double driftVelocity)
      Evaluates all closure equations for one slip ratio.
      Parameters:
      reference - thermodynamic state
      basis - validated two-phase basis
      slipRatio - gas velocity divided by liquid velocity
      surfaceTensionNm - interfacial tension in N/m, or NaN during root iteration
      driftVelocity - Harmathy drift velocity in m/s
      Returns:
      immutable closure result
